$comment: What this build changed this round, shown to the judge by src/round-notes.ts. Overwrite every round: your round number and 4-5 one-liners. npm run check validates the shape.
notes: The forest now opens into a fourth zone: the flooded cyan Moonwell, with reeds, reflections, and open water
Three visible cross-currents push the wisp off course - movement behaves differently beyond the trees
Spend your reach near a moonstone to wake it, ring the whole basin, and permanently still its current
The final beacon needs fourteen lights and all three moonstones, so reach now changes the world instead of only shortening a route
The ending now pays off the journey from forest to Moonwell and recognizes all four places
